title: Campaign reach and engagement
description: Equal-size colored stickers plot two measurements, with bold outlines, hard shadows and quiet guide lines.

props.name: data
props.description: Observations with unique nonempty id, label, finite signed x and y values or null, and optional categorical tone a–d. Incomplete pairs are omitted and counted explicitly. Colors remain stable by ID; all marks have equal size and zero coordinates remain valid.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Horizontal measurement label; defaults to X value.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Vertical measurement label; defaults to Y value.

props.name: xFormatter
props.description: Formats horizontal tooltip values. Axis ticks use compact notation.

props.name: yFormatter
props.description: Formats vertical tooltip values. Axis ticks use compact notation.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels; otherwise content determines height. Dense plots scroll locally.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable finite native Recharts motion subject to the language tokens and reduced motion.
